title: 💠 The Cold War can be endured.
text:
💠 The Cold War can be endured."
"Information warfare can be countered."
"In air and land warfare, you can see the enemy."

"🔹But have you ever heard of the most complex war in the world?"
"A war where you must remain unseen, yet see clearly..."
